name: Wildeyes
label: Quest
description: Wildeyes: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My servant, Gorzeeki, is an alchemist of some skill. He can prepare the ink I will need for your parchment. I gathered together the blood you acquired; take it to Gorzeeki so that he can begin his work.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have something for me? It's not a big, juicy spider, is it? Or maybe a roach? I hope it's still alive... I so love chewing on them when they're still alive...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, it's blood. It must be from master Mor'zul then. He is so enamored with the stuff, and loves to see it spilled. I, however, prefer it coursing through the veins of a small rodent. It stays warm that way... Until you want it.
This is powerful blood. Mor'zul must be making another parchment to summon a dreadsteed! How exciting!
If that's true, and you're going to perform the ritual, then... You're going to need a lot more than blood, my friend.
